■ This creature gets +1000 power for each of your shields.
■ When you put this creature, choose one of your opponent's creatures. Your opponent puts it on the bottom of their deck.
■ Whenever this creature attacks, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. If you do, shieldify one of them and put the other into your hand.
